summary: 39 units reviewed. 54 issues (8 error, 46 minor). Main errors: unit 49 gram (bahuvrīhi agrees with masculine bastiḥ); 50 non-word mūkara kept in `w` and false 'attested variant' claim; 55 invented 'के साथ'; 57 invented causal 'होने के कारण'; 43 Hindi 'पल भर' means 'a moment'; 61 wrong GROUPING span (59 is complete; run-on is 60-61); 68 'बनाए गए' added; 76 'मेदा' reads as flour. Identifications judged acceptable as hedged: sāhacara, abhīru, nata, ikṣuraka, tāla, ātmaguptā, sārivā, nidigdhikā; gonarda hedged but 'bird' is assumed; yaṣṭikā (44) newly hedged. Damaged units (52, 55, 73) handled as the glossary asks; 72 nata/vakṣīrī division uncertain. Items needing a human: 57 (stambhin referent), 59 (yāpana 'enemas'), 62 (पाण्डुता Hindi), 68 (pṛthak + ablative), 72, 73, 76 (śītapākī/odana). No regrouping needed; sentences run across 40-42, 60-61, 62-63, 70-71, 72-77, 77-78.
glossary_suggestions: vṛṣatama / ativṛṣa: fix 'most aphrodisiac' / 'exceedingly virile' in English and वृष्य in Hindi; never bare 'वृष'.
Hindi unit words: पल, तुला, द्रोण, प्रस्थ kept as Sanskrit; never write 'पल भर'.
Hindi 'मेदा' must carry 'नामक द्रव्य' (else read as flour मैदा).
kukkuṭa = 'fowl' (not hen/cock) unless the text specifies.
pṛthak may take the ablative ('apart from'); decide for 68 vs 70.
Hindi names to reuse: कटसरैया (sahācara), शतावरी (abhīru), बरियार (balā), तालमखाना (ikṣuraka), परवल (paṭola), सुगन्धबाला (hrīvera/udīcya), कमलनाल (bisa/mṛṇāla), तगर (nata).
